import numpy as np
y=dA_dt
def basisA(A,d): return np.column_stack([A**i for i in range(d+1)])
def basist(t,d): return np.column_stack([t**j for j in range(d+1)])
def als2(rank,dA_,dt_,it=500,seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    FA=basisA(A,dA_); Gt=basist(t,dt_)
    G=rng.normal(size=(Gt.shape[1],rank))
    for _ in range(it):
        X=np.hstack([FA*(Gt@G[:,[i]]) for i in range(rank)])
        c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
        Cs=c.reshape(rank,-1).T
        Fv=[FA@Cs[:,i] for i in range(rank)]
        X2=np.hstack([Gt*Fv[i][:,None] for i in range(rank)])
        g,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X2,y,rcond=None)
        G=g.reshape(rank,-1).T
    return G, Cs, np.mean((y-X2@g)**2)/np.var(y)
